dataLocation._instruction: Add the location of the data that are linked to this specific service (e.g., stored as file (bundles) or registered as other entities such as atlas annotations).

displayLabel._instruction: Enter a display label for this service link.

openDataIn._instruction: Enter the internationalized resource identifier (IRI) to the linked data in the specified service.

previewImage._instruction: Add an image file to this service link that acts as a preview of its content or could function as an icon.

service._instruction: Add all services in which the specified data can be opened by linking to each service’s interface (group of versions), specific interface version, or web resource.
